title: medicago helix var. laevis
intro: Medicago helix var. laevis, commonly known as the alpine clover, is a perennial legume plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and possess anti-inflammatory properties. Medicago helix var. laevis is reported to have therapeutic actions such as reducing blood pressure, improving immune function, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
